description: This file contains functions and classes for transforming constraints into Z3 format, generating constraints from a traced graph, and evaluating conditionals with constraints, specifically within the context of migrating gradual types in torch.fx.

methods.name: transform_to_z3
methods.description: Transforms constraints into Z3 expressions, handling conjunctions, disjunctions, and various constraint types.

methods.name: transform_var
methods.description: Transforms tensor variables into Z3 format, considering tensor types and dynamic dimensions.

methods.name: transform_dimension
methods.description: Converts dimension variables or integers into a tuple representation for Z3 encoding.

methods.name: transform_algebraic_expression
methods.description: Transforms algebraic expressions involving dimensions into Z3 format.

methods.name: transform_all_constraints
methods.description: Generates and transforms constraints from a trace into Z3 format, applying fixed point iteration.

methods.name: iterate_till_fixed_point
methods.description: Repeatedly transforms constraints until a fixed point is reached.

methods.name: transform_all_constraints_trace_time
methods.description: Generates two sets of constraints for a node and graph, one for the condition and one for its negation, transforming them into Z3.

methods.name: evaluate_conditional_with_constraints
methods.description: Evaluates a conditional node and its negation within the context of constraints using Z3 solver.
